tasks.label: rebuild-server-and-restart-container
tasks.command: dotnet build Intersect.sln -c Debug ; docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --build ; docker logs -f intersect-server

tasks.label: build-and-restart-container-logs
tasks.command: dotnet build Intersect.sln -c Debug ; docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --build ; docker logs -f --since=10s intersect-server
